formations.method: half-court slot coordinates in feet for a team attacking right; the alternate formation brings the handler to the elbow so pull-ups are not all above the break
formations.script: hand-authored formation geometry, reviewed against the shot zone shares
formations.source: modern five-out half-court spacing; three perimeter slots and two interior slots

freethrow.method: 回合事件文本里的 Free Throw 行逐次计数

policy.method: coordinate descent on the induced shot and possession distributions
policy.source: prior; refined by scripts/calibrate/fit_policy.py moment matching

possession.method: 按回合起始语境分组统计结局速率与时长分位

rebound.method: 分区相对差异来自事件文本的首次投失归组；总水平取 possession 表的 oreb_per_miss 后按分区投失占比等比缩放
rebound.source: shufinskiy/nba_data pbpstats possession table + event text

shot_make.contest: modeled: centred at 0.5 so the fitted mean is preserved; sensitivity documented in table
shot_make.method: empirical make rate per (shot kind, distance bin, two/three), sparse cells smoothed toward the kind mean

shot_profile.method: 投篮档案逐球统计出手类型、区域与来源份额，按样本数归一
